verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs explicitly cover implementing MFA (appwrite-docs-4) and OAuth-based logins with 30+ providers (appwrite-docs-1, appwrite-docs-26), satisfying the MFA half of the story. However, there is no evidence of enterprise SSO protocols like SAML or OIDC being supported — only generic OAuth (Google, GitHub, Facebook, etc.) is documented, which is not the same as enterprise-grade SAML/OIDC federation. Missing for 10: explicit SAML/OIDC enterprise SSO support, admin-enforced MFA/SSO policy controls, and any enterprise identity-provider integration docs.
